# audit

Lists audit events of the workspace (exit 4 when nothing matches) or exports them to a file only you can read.

```
centcom audit list [--actor <id>] [--action <name>] [--from <time>] [--to <time>] [--json] | export --format csv|json [--out <file>] [--wait]
```
